question: The Export Preparedness Index India is developed by ______.

options.text: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

solution:
The correct answer is __**NITI Aayog**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Export Preparedness Index (EPI)** is developed by **NITI Aayog** in collaboration with the **Institute of Competitiveness**.
 
• The EPI aims to identify challenges and opportunities, enhance the effectiveness of government policies, and promote a facilitative regulatory framework for export growth in India.
 
• The first edition of the Export Preparedness Index was released in **August 2020**, and it aims to rank states and union territories based on their export performance and export ecosystem.
 
• The EPI evaluates states on four pillars: **Policy, Business Ecosystem, Export Ecosystem, and Export Performance**.
 
• **Gujarat** emerged as the top-performing state in the first edition of the EPI, followed by **Maharashtra** and **Tamil Nadu**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **NITI Aayog:**

 
 
• **NITI Aayog** stands for **National Institution for Transforming India**.
 
• It was established in **2015** as a policy think tank of the Government of India, replacing the Planning Commission.
 
• The organization provides strategic and technical advice to the central and state governments.
 
• NITI Aayog focuses on fostering cooperative federalism through structured support initiatives and mechanisms with the states.
 
 
 
• **Export Preparedness Index (EPI) Pillars:**
 
 
• **Policy:** Examines export-related policies at the state level to support exports.
 
• **Business Ecosystem:** Evaluates the ease of doing business in a state to promote exports.
 
• **Export Ecosystem:** Analyzes the export-related infrastructure and trade support available in a state.
 
• **Export Performance:** Measures the actual export performance of the states and union territories.
 
 
 
• **Significance of EPI:**
 
 
• Helps identify strengths and weaknesses of the export ecosystem at the state level.
 
• Encourages healthy competition among states and union territories to improve their export ecosystem.
 
• Provides a comprehensive framework to policymakers for boosting exports.
 
 
 
• **Other Related Indices by NITI Aayog:**
 
 
• **India Innovation Index:** Measures innovation performance of states and union territories.
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Index:** Tracks the progress of states and UTs toward achieving SDGs.
 
• **Health Index:** Evaluates the performance of states in the health sector.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Export Preparedness Index** is India's first comprehensive tool for ranking states and union territories on their export performance and readiness.
 
• It encourages state-level initiatives to improve export competitiveness and provides actionable insights for policymakers.
 
• **Gujarat**, with its robust industrial base and export-oriented policies, has consistently performed well in the EPI rankings.
 
• The EPI also highlights the role of **district-level export hubs** in promoting local products and contributing to the national export strategy.
